samples.summary: Browser login now dead-ends on a raw backend 400 when the OAuth state cookie is gone; the frontend consumer has no error path
samples.evidence: The frontend's only OAuth entry point is `packages/frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx:27` (`<Link to={VITE_BACKEND_API_URL}/auth/github>`), and `packages/frontend/src/app/login/page.tsx` (whole file) has no handling for a failed callback — there is no `?error=` route and no other consumer of the callback. Previously `GET /auth/github/callback` always ended in `res.redirect(FRONTEND_URL)`; it now throws `BadRequestException` (packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:131-150) whenever `wafflebase_oauth_state` is absent or mismatched. Reachable without any attacker: the cookie's `STATE_COOKIE_MAX_AGE_MS` is 10 minutes (packages/backend/src/auth/oauth-state.ts), shorter than a first-time GitHub signup/2FA leg; and because the cookie is set at a fixed name/path on every `/auth/github` visit, a second login tab overwrites the first tab's secret, so the earlier tab's callback also 400s. The user lands on the backend origin looking at raw Nest JSON with no way back. Fix belongs either on the new callback code (redirect to `FRONTEND_URL` with an error query instead of throwing) or on the frontend login page.

samples.summary: `sheets.export` schema entry not updated for the new `--raw` flag (and the changed default CSV behaviour)
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts:567-579 still lists only `--tab`, `--range`, `--file-format` for `sheets.export`. `wafflebase schema` is the machine-readable contract agents read (docs/design/cli.md §; packages/cli/skills/*), and packages/cli/skills/recipe-csv-pipeline.md:51 now instructs agents to pass `--raw`, a flag the schema says does not exist. The response description (`Formatted cell data`) also does not record that CSV output is now formula-neutralized by default.

samples.summary: The primary export skill doc still documents the old verbatim CSV export; no `--raw`, no formula-guard note
samples.evidence: packages/cli/skills/sheets-import-export.md:89-93 lists the `sheets export` options as `--tab`, `--range`, `--file-format` only, and lines 63-87 show plain export examples. With the new default (`neutralizeFormulas: !--raw`, packages/cli/src/commands/sheets-export.ts:63) an agent following this skill and re-importing gets every `=SUM(...)` turned into the literal text `'=SUM(...)`. Only packages/cli/skills/recipe-csv-pipeline.md was updated.

samples.summary: Agent round-trip charter states two identities that the new default CSV neutralization makes false
samples.evidence: scripts/agent/charters/round-trip.md:15 (`sheets import` a CSV then `sheets export` CSV → the same data) and :19 (the same data under `--format json` and `--format csv` agrees) are now false by default for any value starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` — exactly the values line 23-25 tells the hunter to choose. This charter drives the automated hunter lane, so it will now manufacture false findings unless it records the `--raw` exception.

samples.summary: Backend design doc and README still describe the pre-change `/auth/github` contract
samples.evidence: docs/design/backend.md:103-115 documents `GET /auth/github` as `Guard: AuthGuard('github')` that simply "Redirects to GitHub's authorization page", and the callback as always ending in a redirect to `FRONTEND_URL`. Both are now wrong: the route is guarded by `GitHubAuthGuard` plus `CliLoginConfirmMiddleware` (packages/backend/src/auth/auth.module.ts:48) which answers `?mode=cli` with a confirmation page, and the callback rejects any request without a matching `state` (packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:131). packages/backend/README.md:387-399 repeats the same stale flow with no mention of the state cookie. docs/design/rest-api.md and docs/design/cli.md were updated; these two were not.

finding.summary: Browser login now dead-ends on a raw backend 400 when the OAuth state cookie is gone; the frontend consumer has no error path
finding.evidence: The frontend's only OAuth entry point is `packages/frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx:27` (`<Link to={VITE_BACKEND_API_URL}/auth/github>`), and `packages/frontend/src/app/login/page.tsx` (whole file) has no handling for a failed callback — there is no `?error=` route and no other consumer of the callback. Previously `GET /auth/github/callback` always ended in `res.redirect(FRONTEND_URL)`; it now throws `BadRequestException` (packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:131-150) whenever `wafflebase_oauth_state` is absent or mismatched. Reachable without any attacker: the cookie's `STATE_COOKIE_MAX_AGE_MS` is 10 minutes (packages/backend/src/auth/oauth-state.ts), shorter than a first-time GitHub signup/2FA leg; and because the cookie is set at a fixed name/path on every `/auth/github` visit, a second login tab overwrites the first tab's secret, so the earlier tab's callback also 400s. verdict.reason: Every element of the finding verifies. auth.controller.ts:131-135 and :146-150 throw BadRequestException on missing/mismatched OAuth state, and only the success path reaches res.redirect(FRONTEND_URL) at :183; there is no global exception filter in packages/backend/src (grep for ExceptionFilter/useGlobalFilters/Catch( returned nothing), so the user is left on the backend origin viewing raw Nest JSON. The failure is reachable with no attacker: oauth-state.ts:26 caps the state cookie at 10 minutes, and github-auth.guard.ts:64-68 re-issues the same fixed-name, fixed-path cookie (oauth-state.ts:20, :65) on every browser /auth/github visit, so a second login tab clobbers the first tab's secret and the earlier tab's callback fails webOAuthStateMatches (oauth-state.ts:47-55). On the consumer side, login-form.tsx:26-29 is the only frontend OAuth entry point, and login/page.tsx:14-80 renders LoginForm with no query-param/error handling; a repo-wide grep for error=/useSearchParams/oauth in packages/frontend/src shows no login-related handling, and the only other /auth/github consumer is the CLI (packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:40), which has its own loopback path. This is a changed endpoint contract (always-redirect -> may 400) with an out-of-diff consumer left broken, which is in the blast-radius lane and major per the rubric.
